柏格醫生 dr berg 談：哪些是高鉀食物，有助預防缺鉀、維持電解質平衡，改善整體健康。
多數人想補鉀，都會被建議吃香蕉。 高鉀含量的香蕉、馬鈴薯、大蕉、豆類和地瓜，其實不是最好的選擇。 雖然這些食物含鉀，但也含高糖。

ns2:group.ns2:title: Inside China's AI data center, servers cooled in liquid
ns2:group.ns2:description:
At China Mobile’s Qingyang data center, a new cooling method is reshaping how AI compute stays online.
Servers are fully immersed in a special liquid, allowing heat to be carried away far more efficiently — a setup known as immersion liquid cooling, ideal for high-density AI clusters.
A guide at the site said the machines are submerged top to bottom in fluorinated fluid. With no fans, the usual noise disappears — leaving only a faint electric hum.
As heat management becomes a key bottleneck for AI infrastructure, liquid cooling is gaining traction fast.
